packageRules.description: go-smb2 is the whole SMB side and the login: every update in a pull request of its own, never automerged, so its changes to the session setup are read before they ship

oapi-codegen generates api/v1, and an update has to commit `make generate-api` with it (api/v1/generate_test.go fails otherwise): a pull request of its own, never automerged, so it does not hold the other Go updates back
Group the interface's Angular packages: they release together and must move together
The interface's TypeScript follows what Angular supports (@angular/compiler-cli's peer range: 6.0 for Angular 22); a major update comes with the Angular update that allows it
go-smb2 is a patched copy in third_party (third_party/go-smb2/PATCHES.md): updated by hand, with the patches rebased
